task_reconstruction.official_task: Reduce both the average waiting time and its variance at airport security checkpoints.

section_map.summary: Summary names the 98 percent screening wait.
Three-passenger preparation zone cuts the wait share to 57.21 percent.

contributions.summary: A shared preparation zone sized by diminishing returns.
Priority lanes whose bad threshold settings do no harm.

dependency_graph.handoff: the screening queue identified as the bottleneck
the four-lane layout and the arrival process

assumptions.summary: Arrival gaps are independent, hence Poisson.
No emergency incidents, and transit time between stations is ignored.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Means and deviations computed from supplied excel data.

models.summary: Poisson arrivals, Gaussian service, screening as the slower scan.
Shared preparation zone, best at 3 passengers.
Three priority groups and one emergency lane.

verification.summary: 31678 samples summarized by mean and RMS.

results_trace.summary: Mean 518.6 s, RMS 269.2 s, nearly uniform.
Screening wait is 98.11 percent of total time.
At 3 passengers preparing, the wait share falls to 57.21 percent.
Elderly and children policy changes the average only slightly.

writing_logic.summary: Each distribution is named with the independence that justifies it.
The count stops where more passengers buy little and crowd the zone.
Each result becomes one numbered action.

language_observations.summary: Both the average and the variance are named as targets.
A bad parameter setting is reported as harmless.
An official policy is reported as ineffective.

visualization_observations.summary: Figures 10 and 11 compare the time shares before and after the linkage change.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A before-and-after share, 98.11 to 57.21 percent, makes the gain checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Refit the arrival process with lambda as a rate and compare with the printed form.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Screening time is the slower of two scans.
Means and deviations traced to the excel data.
Sample count, mean and RMS reported together.
Lane ratio chosen for a stable variance.
Preparation count chosen by diminishing returns.
Two targets named before the model.
Notation table mislabels symbols. Kept as printed.
Lambda used as both rate and interval. Both kept.

unresolved_questions: Table 1 assigns the definition of a standard deviation to Tavg and of a total time to sigma_T. Kept as printed.
Equation 1 treats lambda as a rate while the prose calls it an average time interval. Both kept.
No single optimal pair of tad1 and tad2 is reported. The grid result is kept as printed.
